text:
zoe kim: Quick micro-play idea: 'flashseed' 10 launch posts + 2-step onboarding nudge + tiny demo webinar. Goal: get new signups to run a starter prompt within 48h. Small sample only. Thoughts?
isha rao: Love the name. Keep it tiny: 600 impressions, seed 120 users with 20 credits each. We'll A/B subject lines and a CTA placement test.
matt epps: I can own routing + cohort tagging. Plan: set utm_campaign=flashseed and tag users with cohort flashseed_v1 on credit grant. Pseudocode: 
```
if (request.query.utm_campaign == 'flashseed') {
  user.cohort = 'flashseed_v1';
  emit('flashseed.credited');
}
```
riley cho: Landing asks: reduce hero lines, one primary CTA 'Run starter prompt', preselect a template on success page. I can push a small variant to staging by EOD.
isha rao: Copy: tone = practical + hands-on. Highlight "20 free credits + 2 starter prompts". Subject A: "20 credits to try Redwood prompts" Subject B: "Ship an AI demo tonight 1 credits inside"
zoe kim: Metrics: signup -> prompt-run (24h), first API call, retention 24h. We'll instrument cohort in GA + internal analytics. If prompt-run < 30% after 24h, pause and iterate.
matt epps: Tech note: will add feature flag flashseed_grant and expose event flashseed_prompt_run. I'll open a tiny PR for the grant service.
launch-bot: Reminder: campaign jobs need 36h lead time. Schedule accordingly.
zoe kim: Timeline: prep Wed, soft launch Thurs 9am PT to 600 impressions, measure 48-72h. Webinar Fri 11am PT 10-min demo + Qs. Decision rule: scale if prompt-run lift >12%.
isha rao: I'll draft two short social posts and the email variants; will include ?utm_campaign=flashseed. Drafts in #marketing-drafts in 90m.
riley cho: Staging variant will include 'Run this prompt' button on success page. Also adding a tiny in-app nudge if no prompt-run in 6 hours.\oMatt epps: PR opened for routing and flag.
zoe kim: Great. Go ahead with 120 users x 20 credits. Keep it lean. If green, scale to 6k impressions next wave. Thanks team :rocket:
